**Some shops need a ScraperAPI key. Most of what Biryar does needs none.**

When Biryar reads a shop it says honestly that it is a program. Some shops
answer only to web browsers and turn everything else away, and Biryar does
not pretend to be a browser. Those shops are read through
[ScraperAPI](https://www.scraperapi.com/), a service built for exactly
this. The account is yours, and so are the credits a scan spends; Biryar
does not resell them.

## Which shops need it

In the list of retailers, every shop says one of two things under its
name: **no key needed** or **needs ScraperAPI**. For the shops Biryar
ships with:

| Shop | Country | |
|---|---|---|
| Barnes & Noble | United States | no key needed |
| MediaMarkt | Germany | no key needed |
| rebuy | Germany | no key needed |
| Saturn | Germany | no key needed |
| Terrashop | Germany | no key needed |
| Argos | United Kingdom | needs ScraperAPI |
| Blackwell's | United Kingdom | needs ScraperAPI |
| Currys | United Kingdom | needs ScraperAPI |
| Hive | United Kingdom | needs ScraperAPI |
| HMV | United Kingdom | needs ScraperAPI |
| Hugendubel | Germany | needs ScraperAPI |
| iHerb | United States | needs ScraperAPI |
| Medimops | Germany | needs ScraperAPI |
| Müller | Germany | needs ScraperAPI |
| Ryman | United Kingdom | needs ScraperAPI |
| Walmart | United States | needs ScraperAPI |
| World of Books | United Kingdom | needs ScraperAPI |
| zooplus | Germany | needs ScraperAPI |

So you can try Sourcing without a ScraperAPI account: five shops work with
a Keepa key alone.

## Adding the key

1. Make an account at [scraperapi.com](https://www.scraperapi.com/) and
   copy the API key from its dashboard.
2. In Biryar, open **Settings, Connections**. Under **Keys for other
   services**, paste it beside **ScraperAPI** and save.

The key is locked away on your computer the moment it is saved, and it is
never shown again, not even to you. To replace it, paste the new one.

## What it costs

ScraperAPI charges in credits, and every page Biryar reads through it
spends some. Most shops cost one credit a page. Hugendubel, zooplus and
Müller need an extra option from ScraperAPI and cost several credits a
page; ScraperAPI's own price list says how many, and a few options are
only part of its larger plans.

A pass of 200 pages is therefore at least 200 credits. ScraperAPI's
dashboard shows how many you have left.

## When the credits run out

Nothing breaks, and nothing is wrong with the shop. Biryar tells you in
plain words:

> Your ScraperAPI credits are used up, so Müller could not be read.
> Nothing is wrong with the shop.

Three things then happen:

- The key shows as **used up** under Settings, Connections, with what
  ScraperAPI answered.
- A notice appears in Biryar, once a day at most.
- Shops kept running by themselves try again once an hour, and carry on
  from where they stopped as soon as the account answers again. You do not
  have to restart anything.

Shops marked **no key needed** are not affected and keep running.

## Other messages

| It says | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| The scraping service rejected the key | The key is wrong, or the account was closed. | Paste the key again from the ScraperAPI dashboard. |
| The scraping account's plan does not include an option this retailer needs | That shop needs an option your ScraperAPI plan does not have. | Waiting will not help. Use a larger plan, or leave that shop out. |
| This retailer needs a scraping key and none is set | The shop is marked needs ScraperAPI and no key is saved. | Add the key as above. |
